manifest.description: Built-in email client. Gmail and Microsoft accounts are signed in once in Settings → Accounts (shared with Calendar); generic SMTP/IMAP (PureMail) mailboxes are added here. Left-sidebar account/folder list, right-sidebar message preview, and a full workspace page to read, sync and compose.
